query:
SELECT
                        posts.post_snowflake,
                        posts.content,
                        users.user_snowflake,
                        users.handle
                    FROM
                        posts.posts NATURAL JOIN users.users
                    WHERE
                        posts.post_snowflake > $1
                    ORDER BY
                        posts.post_snowflake
                    ASC
                    LIMIT $2
